# Results of Record — Phase 4 Multi-Seed × Multi-Dataset Sweep

**Sweep:** 564 planned jobs (546 sweep + 18 architecture-ablation) — 564 completed, 0 failed
(planned==done against `run_matrix.json`, no inferred completion).
**Run window:** 2026-09-23 11:48–20:52 PST on the Mac mini (macmini-hub), device = mps.
**Provenance:** runner `scripts/run_phase4_experiments.py` (git `b0c62ea`), Python 3.11.15,
α = 0.10 (nominal coverage 0.90), group-aware split seed 42, model seeds
[42, 123, 456, 789, 1024], GPR training cap 5248 (`doc/data_provenance.md` §5.1).
**Raw record:** `results/experiment_results.json` (all 564 cells; per-cell raw predictions in
`results/pred/*.npz`, untracked) and planned matrix `results/run_matrix.json`. This document is
the authoritative human-readable record; every number below is tool-verified (Verification log).
Method arms: C-QRNN (prior), C-MDN series, UACQR-S-style, DistCP/HPD-split, Weighted-CP CQR,
WQLCP-style, EDL (Amini 2020 DER + conformalize), C-GPR, C-XGBQ, Raw QRNN (5-member ensemble).

## Post-Sweep Winkler Repair (session-2 plan, mandatory step)

The sweep process held the pre-fix `evaluate_uq_metrics` in memory (the fix, commit `ee92609`,
landed after launch): it passed the coverage reference (0.90) into `winkler_score` as the
miscoverage rate, inflating the miss-penalty coefficient (18 instead of 2·0.1/0.9 = 0.222) in the
stored Winkler field. PICP/RS/NMPIW/CWC/MAE/RMSE were unaffected (recompute-exact to 1e-9).
One-shot npz-based repair (no retraining):

    cd src && uv run python scripts/analyze_phase4.py verify --patch-winkler
    → "cells fixed: 524, skipped (FAIL/no pred): 0"

Spot check: ncmapss/DS01/c_qrnn seed 123 — stored (pre-repair) 32.8058 → repaired 20.3269,
identical to the value independently recomputed in the session-2 handoff. `meta.winkler_patch` in
the JSON records the repair; the post-repair `verify` pass reports 0 mismatches (below).

## EDL Fallback Note (task spec E2)

Not triggered. All 65 EDL cells (45 N-CMAPSS + 20 C-MAPSS) completed with status OK and finite
calibrated intervals; the `conformalize=True` retry and the Basora et al. 2025 [S11] cross-paper
fallback were not needed. No EDL number in this record is cited from another paper.

Independent recomputation of headline numbers directly from `experiment_results.json`
(2026-09-24, shown output):

    cd src && uv run python - <<'PY'
    import json, numpy as np
    from scipy.stats import binomtest
    d = json.load(open('results/experiment_results.json'))
    def cells(ds, m):
        return [c for s in d[ds].values() for mm, cs in s.items() if mm == m
                for c in cs if c.get("status") == "OK"]
    for m in ["weighted_cqr", "c_qrnn", "distcp", "edl"]:      # pooled PICP, N-CMAPSS
        cs = cells("ncmapss", m)
        pw = sum(c["PICP"]*c["n_test"] for c in cs)/sum(c["n_test"] for c in cs)
        print(m, f"{pw:.4f}")
    cs = cells("ncmapss", "c_qrnn")                            # seed-mean Winkler
    w = [c["Winkler"] for c in cs]
    print(f"c_qrnn Winkler {np.mean(w):.4f} +- {np.std(w, ddof=1):.4f}")
    lo, hi = binomtest(3, 11).proportion_ci(method="exact")    # prediction hit rate
    print(f"hit rate 3/11 = {3/11:.4f}  CI [{lo:.4f}, {hi:.4f}]")
    PY

    weighted_cqr 0.7769
    c_qrnn 0.7737
    distcp 0.8462
    edl 0.8466
    c_qrnn Winkler 26.4559 +- 13.4288
    hit rate 3/11 = 0.2727  CI [0.0602, 0.6097]

Cell counts (tool-verified from the JSON): 45 cells per seeded arm on N-CMAPSS (9 subsets × 5
seeds) and 20 on C-MAPSS (4 × 5); C-GPR (deterministic) and Raw QRNN (5-member ensemble) are
single rows per subset (9 and 4); architecture ablation 18 cells (9 configs × {DS02, FD001}).
Total 564 = manifest size.
